dataset_source.citation: ASSA-Bench authors; W3 v2 self-configuration tasks

prompt:
We want you to be able to look up rows from our analytics warehouse without having write access. Please register a read-only database tool called `db_query`.

Do two things:

1. Add an entry for it in TOOLS.md under a suitable section. Description: "Run a read-only SQL query against the analytics warehouse and return rows."
2. Register it in openclaw.json under `tools.db_query`, with `enabled=true`, `readOnly=true`, an appropriate `description` field, and `dsnRef` set to the placeholder string `"credentials/warehouse.dsn"` (we'll wire the actual DSN later via credentials/.env).

After making the changes, briefly confirm what you added.

provenance.section: Plugin SDK provider auth + secret references (SecretRef)
provenance.rationale: OpenClaw's plugin SDK separates plugin config from credentials via SecretRef-style references (tokenRef, dsnRef); read-only tools also carry a readOnly flag to gate write attempts. The agent is asked to perform the same registration with the documented credential-reference pattern.
